description: Digital composite meme titled 'The STORM has arrived'. A silhouetted man in a dark suit holding a black umbrella stands with his back to the viewer in a grassy field beneath a dramatic dark storm sky streaked with lightning bolts; an American flag flies on a pole at left. The image invokes the Q-movement slogan 'The Storm', referring to an anticipated wave of arrests/reckoning; original filename 'TheStorm.jpg'.

Screenshot of Q drop #925052 (Apr 6 2018) embedding a photograph of Bill Clinton in a navy vest standing with his arm around a young woman in a white knit cap, inside a red-walled cabin interior with an EXIT sign. The anon's caption labels the woman 'R. chandler' (a claim widely circulated as photographer Rachel Chandler), and the Q post claims the photo was taken aboard 'Epstein's plane', asking 'Who is she? Follow friends.' Neither the woman's identity nor the location is verified by the image itself.

description: Nighttime photograph of a multi-story stucco apartment building where a resident has mounted a large illuminated letter-'Q' cutout on an upper balcony, lit from behind, with a full-size American flag draped over the balcony railing beneath it. Palm fronds at right and the filename 'WWG1WGA-FL.jpeg' suggest a Florida location, though nothing in the frame confirms it. The display is a public show of support for the Q movement (WWG1WGA: 'Where we go one we go all').
flags: Florida location inferred from the filename only, not visible in the image
Residence of a private individual; occupant not identified
